desc: The Company has fixed 15th September, 2026 (Tuesday) as Record Date for the recommended final dividend i.e. Rs. 0.70/- per paid-up equity share of Rs. 10/- each, subject  to the approval of the shareholders in the ensuing 46th Annual General Meeting of the Company.
Newspaper Publication regarding the date of Annual General Meeting, Record Date and E-Voting Information

Pursuant to Regulation 30 of SEBI (LODR) this is to inform you that National Stock Exchange of India Limited vide its circular no. NSE/CML/73797 dated April 17, 2026 has notified that  the equity shares of Frontier Springs Limited have been permitted to trade  on National Stock Exchange  with effect from April 20, 2026 under "Permitted to Trade" category.
